name: Bench Press
description: Lie on the bench, lower the bar to your chest, then push it back up.

name: Squat
description: With the bar on your back, bend your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand up.

name: Biceps Curl
description: Keep your elbows close to your body and lift the dumbbells to your shoulders.

name: Pull-up
description: Hang from the bar and pull yourself up until your chin is above it.

name: Crunches
description: Lie on your back, knees bent, and lift your shoulders off the floor.
